v0.1.1.description:
# Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness — Archipelago

This is the first release of my Pokemon XD Apworld. It feels quite stable right now, but definitely has quirks/bugs I've missed. Please refrain from bringing this into multiworlds where people may not be expecting to deal with bugs, softlocks, or other issues. Feel free to report any bugs you find.

## Check types

| Category | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Trainer defeats | 564 | Cumulative (`Defeat N Trainers`) or one per unique team |
| Shadow Pokémon catches | 387 | Only species this seed can actually obtain |
| Shop purchases | 96 | Across 9 shops |
| Chests | 95 | |
| Purifications | up to 127 | |
| Travel unlocks | 11 | Location Shuffle only |

~1,190 location names total

## Randomization

- **Shadow Pokémon species** - every Shadow Pokemon shuffled
- **Shadow Pokémon Expansion** - up to 44 extra Shadow Pokemon added to trainers who have space
- **Chests** - 95 chests
- **Shops** - 9 shops, prices dependent on filler/useful/progressive
- **Poké Spots** - all 11 wild slots reassigned to species the seed cannot otherwise obtain (always on)
- **Trainer movesets** - drawn from each Pokémon's learnset
- **Key items** - Data ROM & ID Card, System Lever, Mayor's Note, Music Disc, Scooter Upgrade
- **Travel destinations** (Location Shuffle) - reach areas in any order

## Difficulty

- **Enhanced Difficulty** - pad enemy teams by one, two, or fill to six
- **Enhanced Difficulty Level Scaling** - scales enemy trainer teams by 1.33x
- **Path Level Scaling** - trainers scaled to the Archipelago sphere they're found in/intended order (Location Shuffle)
- **Experience Rate** - 100–1000%
- **Max Catch Rate** - optional guaranteed catches
- **Robo Kyogre Parts** - collect N of M to unlock Citadark Isle

## Quality of life

- **Agate Village Pit Stop** - Agate's shop sells balls and medicine instead of AP items
- **Disable Move Animations** - faster battles
- **Death Link**
- **Configurable filler weights** - balls, medicine, TMs, evolution stones, berries, battle items, treasure, flutes, Poké Coupons
- **Progression controls** - which check categories can hold progression, a purification cap, and a Citadark Isle weighting
- **Forceable Miror B Spawn** - /mirorforce {pyrite/realgam/oasis/cave/rock}

## Goals

- Defeat Greevil
- Win Mt. Battle

## Client

- Item delivery, check detection and Death Link
- Shop shelves renamed live to show which line is which check, and repriced by what they hold
- Shop descriptions show the actual AP item a line will send
- Helpful commands: /mirorforce {pyrite/realgam/cave/oasis/rock}, /shadowdex

## Requirements

- Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness (USA) ISO - not supplied
- Dolphin
- Archipelago 0.6.7 or later

## Known issues

- Wild Poké Spot Pokémon are occasionally level 0 - likely to just be a display issue
- "Shiny" chests (the ID Card's chest and five others) are filler-only until their behaviour is understood.
- Shop expansion items are filler-only temporarily.
- Please feel free to report absolutely anything, even if it's known.

v0.1.2.description:
## Universal Tracker

- New changes to logic and features have made Universal Tracker much more reliable. If issues are found, please let me know.

## New options

- **`randomize_starter`**: `off`, `random_no_legendary` or `true_random`.
  - The starter is given with legal moves and always at least one attacking move, and Chobin is always winnable.
- **`catch_rate_scaling`**: every Shadow is easier to snag.
  - Now has guaranteed catches AND logic-sphere-based scaling as options.
- **`purification_rate`** (100–1000%): shrinks every Shadow's heart gauge, so battles, walking and Scents purify faster.
- **`purification_checks`**: turns all "Purify N" checks on or off.
- **`nightmare_citadark`**: Citadark trainers have level-100, six-Pokémon teams taken from XD's Orre Colosseum and Colosseum's Battle Mode, with their own AI.
  - This is hard. Like stupid hard and gimmicky. But the teams are really funny and are a challenge.
  - The other Citadark Shadows move to unmissable trainers elsewhere.
- **`nightmare_greevil`**: a Nightmare team for Greevil's final battle only.
- **`remove_citadark_shadows`** / **`remove_greevil_shadows`**: those Shadows move to trainers elsewhere. 
- **`no_legendary_shadows`**: no legendary Shadow Pokémon.
- **`shuffle_shadow_lugia`**: Shadow Lugia trades places with a random Shadow.
- **`legendary_trainer_pokemon`**: Trainers can have non-shadow legendaries.
- **`max_catch_rate_exclude_citadark`** / **`max_catch_rate_exclude_greevil`**: Removes guaranteed-catch in the endgame to maintain challenge against shadow teams.
- **`trade_evolutions_by_level`**: trade evolutions happen by level instead.
  - Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler and Haunter at 37.
  - Onix, Scyther and Porygon at 30; Seadra at 40; Poliwhirl to Politoed at 36.
  - Clamperl and Slowpoke branch by personality.
- **`reduce_citadark_grind`**: Gateon's late shop tier (after all Robo Kyogre Parts or at the end of the story) sells a Rare Candy and a **Candy Box**
  - A Candy Box levels a Pokémon to 100, or to 99 if it has two evolutions ahead. 
  - It teaches every level-up move passed along the way.
  - Works with randomize shops on or off.
- **`text_speed`** (normal / fast / instant), **`hold_b_to_advance`** and **`battle_speed`** (normal / fast / faster).
- **`citadark_story_weight`** (0–100, default 85): For Vanilla locations - weights Robo Kyogre Parts late so that you usually have to complete more of the story. 0 means they go anywhere

## Changed or removed options

- **`randomize_chests` removed.** Chests are always checks - fixed tracker issues.
- **`shuffle_trainer_movesets` removed.** Gen III-legal trainer movesets are always on.
- **`purification_progression_cap`** covers 0–127 and is lowered to fit the seed instead of failing.
- **Robo Kyogre Parts:** if more are required than are available, the available count is raised to match.
- **`trainer_defeat_mode: cumulative`** is only the "Defeat N Trainers" checks
- **Mt. Battle goal:** completes on beating Battlus, the 100th trainer, fixed from simply sending after 100 defeats
- **Slot names can now be up to 16 characters**, and your in-game trainer name no longer has to match

## New Items

- **AbilitySwap and Candy Box** - AbilitySwap is available in Gateon upon getting all Robo Kyogre Parts, and Candy Box is there too if enabled in its option.
  - Ability Patch cycles your pokemon's ability, and Candy Box levels them to 100 instantly (or 99 if they need two evos)

## Gameplay and logic

- **Shadow catch checks** are gated by the fight that actually carries them/fixed some logic issues with re-fights.
- **"Purify N" and "Defeat N Trainers"** count only what you can actually reach.
- **Robo Kyogre Parts** never land on Citadark Isle.
- **Trainer teams**
  - Teams no longer have so many duplicates.
  - Stone, trade and friendship evolutions will now happen on trainer teams at certain levels
  - Movesets are Gen III-legal: level-up moves plus one TM, tutor or egg move the species can really learn.
- **Shadow Pokémon** get legal moves for their randomized species.
- **Key-item story holds** (with Key Item Shuffle on)
  - Opening the Music Disc chest, or the Gateon parts shop with Location Shuffle off, no longer advances the story before you receive the item.

## Checks and locations

- **Unlock checks** send the moment the game reveals that destination on the map.
- **Krane Memo checks** send when the memo enters your Bag and the client removes it.
- **Fights you only watch send nothing:** Ardos vs Zook at Gateon, and Zook vs Biden at the Key Lair.
  - Ardos, Zook and Biden each have one (Any) check, sent by beating them at Citadark, the Key Lair and Snagem respectively.
- **Missable trainers** are filler-only and auto-sent once their area's story moves past them, judged per area with Location Shuffle on.
- **There is a Purify check for every Shadow in your seed:** 83, plus up to 44 from the Shadow Expansion.
- **A seed contains only the locations its options select - for Universal Tracker**
- **`!hint ID Card` and `!hint Data ROM`** now hint "Data ROM & ID Card".

## Client

- **Universal Tracker:** Should be functional. Please report bugs.
- **Death Link** works, including mid-battle: losing a battle sends one, and a received death faints your team on the spot.
- **New or expanded commands:** `!missables`, `!bag`, `!keyitems`, `!unlocks`, `!parts`, `!purifications`, `!shops`, `!deathlink`.
  - `!getitem` gains "99 Candy Boxes".
- **Your save is found without your trainer name.** YAML slot name can now be any length under Archipelago limit.

## Fixes

- You can no longer reach Citadark without the required Parts.
- Poké Spot Pokémon no longer appear at level 0.
- The patcher checks your ISO first. It refuses non-USA discs, other games, bad dumps and already-patched ISOs.
- Zook's Gateon fight no longer sends his check. Same for Ardos.
- Key items you weren't sent are removed reliably.
- Miscellaneous trainer shadow behavior fixes.
- Eagun no longer holds you hostage near the relic stone.

## Known Issues

- Some rematchable trainers may infinitely respawn shadow pokemon when you battle them. Please report where these occur if found.
- Some shop descriptions update slowly on occasion - please also report this. 
- Some shiny chests are not interactable depending on the items you hold - these are all marked filler until i find a solution, and sent upon area complete.

v0.1.4.description:
## New
- **Move tutor:** the Agate tutor can teach every move as many times as you like. 
- **`/toggledeathlink`:** turns Death Link on or off from the client.

## Shadow Pokémon
- **No more respawns:** snagged or purified Shadows are no longer rebuilt when you rematch their trainer.
- **More trainers can carry Shadows:** rematchable trainers can hold Shadows again (Gorps, Jols, Ladi, Cron, Bost, Cida, Dosk, Raling, Labet, Doby).
- **Mirrors:** a trainer's Shadow is copied onto their other fights, so you can still get it if you meet a later team first. Snag it once and it's gone from all of them; beat it and it goes to Miror B.
- **First fights can hold Shadows:** Clerr, Belish, Dosk, Dert, Raling, Labet, Doby and Cail. Their later fights always carry the copy.
- **One per evolution line:** no two Shadow Pokémon share an evolution line when species are randomized or added by the expansion. The one exception is vanilla species, where Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan are both Shadows.
- **Shadow Monitor:** the PDA's Shadow Monitor shows each Shadow's real species.
- **Shuffle Shadow Lugia:** never puts Lugia somewhere without checks.

## Logic and checks
- **No post-game Shadow checks:** Greevil's Shadows and Miror B.'s post-game Dragonite have no checks. That leaves 75 Purify checks in a vanilla roster and up to 119 with the expansion.
- **Mt. Battle goal:** generation now requires Mt. Battle to be reachable, not Citadark.
- **Snag Machine:** you get it without the Machine Part. Shadow catches no longer need the Machine Part in logic.
- **SS Libra:** logically needs only the Phenac unlock, plus the Scooter Upgrade if it's shuffled.
- **Cumulative "Defeat N Trainers":** counts each trainer once and never a missable one. Counts past that are filler-only.
- **Master Ball:** now a useful item, still one per seed.
- **Item group "Key Items":** replaces "Krane Memos" and "Voice Cases".

## Story and travel
- **HQ Lab:** waits for 0x0F and Krane Memos 1–2 before pinning the lab for the Machine Part.
- **SS Libra entry:** stays locked until you have the Phenac unlock, and no longer fails to let you in after a reconnect.
- **Phenac checks:** arriving in Phenac from the SS Libra no longer sends all of Phenac's checks.
- **Vanilla locations:** SS Libra plays the Snag Machine theft as written.
- **Zook at the Key Lair:** beating Zook moves the Key Lair past his fight, so he doesn't come back.
- **Rock Poké Spot:** the tray works. The spots load in at the Duking-news point, and the client repairs the story byte if it slips back.

## Levels
- **Sixes:** with path scaling, the Sixes' Cipher Lab and Phenac fights are each levelled to their own area.

## Client
- **Purification checks:** one check per purification, never two. Fixed purifications being missed when a purified Shadow evolved into another Shadow's species.
- **Death Link:**
  - It now sends off the game's own white-out, counted the moment the white-out begins, instead of reading your party.
  - It no longer sends at full HP or misses real wipes.
  - A death you receive is never sent back out.
- **Commands:** client messages now say `/command` instead of `!command`. The debug catch command is `/catchscan`.
- **Speed:** large multiworlds generate faster with several Pokémon XD players.

## Housekeeping
- Bug-report link and setup-guide author fixed.
- Option descriptions and the game page updated.
- Fixed a Windows-only test failure.
- Added `.gitignore` for compiled Python files.
- Passes Archipelago's general world tests: item pool, manifest and item groups.

v0.1.5.description:
## New options
- **Poke Spot Catch Checks** (On): turn it off to remove the "Catch –" checks for Pokemon found wild only at the Poke Spots. The spots still have their Pokemon.
- **Mt. Battle Progression Checks** (0): with Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers off, each Mt. Battle trainer from 4 to 100 is a check. This many of them, counting from the first, can hold progression. The rest hold filler.
- **Map Shows Trainer Levels** (On): the world map shows each place's trainer level on your first visit
- **Single Master Ball** (On): turn it off to let extra Master Balls be in the filler pool
- **Filler Weight: Master Ball** (0): weight for master balls if single master ball is off
- **All Pokemon Learn All TMs** (Off): every Pokemon can learn every TM.
- **Shadow Move TMs** (0): this many random TMs (up to 18) teach a Shadow move instead, each a different one.
- **Start With Miror Radar and Poke Spots** (Off): start with the Miror Radar and the Poke Spots' unlock. Logic treats the Poke Spots, Miror B. and Shadow catches as open from the start. Needs Location Shuffle; with it off, this option is turned off.
- **Missable Trainer Shadows** (Off): Shadows can also go on missable one-time trainers, whose checks are sent for you when their area is done. A Shadow you don't beat/catch goes to Miror B. Their catch checks never hold progression.

## Checks
### Added
- **Gateon Port – Perr's Machine Part.** Sent when the story reaches Perr's scene at the parts shop, or once the story moves past it. It can hold progression.
- **Mt. Battle – Defeat (trainer)**: 97 checks for trainers 4–100. They exist only in unique trainer-defeat mode with Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers off.
### Removed
- **Numbered rematch checks.** Rematch fights no longer get their own "Defeat X #N" checks, except Naps #2, Smarton #2, Snattle #2, Gorigan #2 and Lovrina #2. Every "Defeat X (Any)" check stays.
- **Kaminko Crane Room Chest 2.** It shares a flag with Chest 1, so the game can't hand out a second item from it.

## Logic
- **Miror B. #2** is fought at the Outskirt Stand. "Defeat Miror B. (Any)" counts if you can reach the Poke Spots or the Outskirt Stand.
- **Aferd, Laken and Hebon** are fixed and can hold progression, since they always battle when talked to.
- **Missable one-time trainers the client sends for you** can hold progression too. With Missable Trainer Shadows on, they can also carry Shadows.
- **Krane Memos 1–5** are all in the HQ Lab. Memos 3–5 need the Machine Part, or the Cipher Lab cleared with the Data ROM & ID Card.
- **Acrod** is behind the System Lever.
- **Ibsol, Jelstin and Fudler** are sent once Gorigan is defeated. They used to be sent the moment you entered the Key Lair.
- **The Sixes' Shadows are only at the Cipher Lab.** At Phenac, that slot is an ordinary Pokemon of the same species.
- **Fuzzer fix** for Location Shuffle seeds. ([#17](<https://github.com/GiovanavoiG/PokemonXD_Archipelago/issues/17>))

## Shadow Pokemon
- **At most two Shadow moves.** Some late-game Shadows (Lugia, the birds, Citadark's) used to keep three or four after being randomized or moved.
- **Every Shadow purifies normally, Lugia included.** 
- **Catch rates**
  - A randomized or swapped Shadow uses its new species' catch rate. A Lugia placed elsewhere is rate 3, then scaled by your settings.
  - Catch Rate Scaling now reaches every Shadow.
  - With Max Catch Rate on, the patcher checks that every Shadow ended up at 255.
- **Missable Trainer Shadows** (new option, off by default)
  - When the trainer's area is done and its Shadow was never snagged, the client hands it to Miror B. and prints "X sent to Miror B. from a missable trainer."
  - Miror B. brings two Shadows at once at the Poke Spots whenever two or more are waiting. Normally that only happens at seven waiting.
  - `/missableshadows` lists them and what has been sent.
- **Shadow catches are also read from the Shadow Monitor**, so a snagged Shadow counts wherever it went afterwards.
- **Miror B.'s Cave Poke Spot Shadow can't be lost.** In the vanilla game, losing that fight means you never meet it again. Now the client hands it to Miror B.'s pool once the story is past it.
- **Purifications are also read from the save's Shadow table.** A Shadow purified in the chamber, moved out of your party, or purified while the client was disconnected still counts, and never twice.

## NPCs
- **Aferd, Laken and Hebon always battle when talked to.** Their teams still follow the story
- **The Agate move tutor** offers all twelve moves from the start.

## Poke Spots
- **All five Pokemon in a Poke Spotare equally likely**, about 20% each. That's its three regulars plus the two shared rare visitors.
- **Wild catch hints** name the spot, e.g. "Cave Spot", or "Rock Spot, Oasis Spot or Cave Spot (rare visitor)". `/catches` shows the same.
- **Stuck spots fixed.** Whiting out at a spot could leave a flag set that stops it spawning. The client now clears that flag once you've left.

## Story and travel
- **HQ Lab memo hold** only holds the lab at the Krane Memo 3–5 step. Gateon's first visit, Perr's scene and the early Machine Part turn-in now play normally.
- **Location Shuffle:** "Unlock – Realgam Tower" is sent the first time you stand in Phenac City. The HQ Lab moves on to the Purify Chamber scene after the Cipher Lab is cleared.

## Escape Rope
- **Always in your Key Items.** Use it from the Bag and you go straight to the world map.
- ⚠️ Using it mid-story (a cutscene area, the SS Libra, Citadark Isle) can leave the story somewhere it doesn't expect. **Save first.**

## Client
- **No lost checks on a bad connection.** Checks found while the connection is down are re-sent until the server confirms them. Chests will likely still fail while disconnected.
- **`/animations on|off`** turns move animations on or off on any patched ISO. The choice is remembered per slot.
- **Saving over an older file no longer sends checks or completes your goal.** The client waits for the save data to settle before reading the story or travel record.
- **`/pokespots`** shows each spot's snacks, waiting Pokemon, Miror B.'s location and more.
- **Slot data carries every YAML option**, for trackers.

## Patching
- **A missing file extension is added back.** If you forget the .iso/.ciso when naming your copy, the source disc's extension is used.

## Trainers and movesets
- **Nightmare Greevil now replaces his real final battle.** It used to change only his post-game rematch, so the goal fight kept a normal randomized team.
- **Trade Evolutions By Level** - Feebas upon reaching age 30 will strive towards beauty and grow into a big weird water snake fish eel.
- **The Candy Box works in every seed.** You can getitem 99 candy boxes regardless of options.
- **Icy Wind** shows up about half as often in trainer movesets.

## For tracker authors
- Slot data includes every option that decides which locations exist or what logic needs, plus `purification_location_count`.
- The client writes the current room id and area name to Data Storage on every room change. The keys are `pokemon_xd_room_{team}_{slot}` and `pokemon_xd_area_{team}_{slot}`, which slot data names as `room_id_key` and `room_area_key`.


## Known Issues
- Rock spot is mean and breaks sometimes on location shuffle. Please report any findings.
